reproduction: Run listed existing tests on exact backend revision with Java17. Extract java.class.path from a Surefire XML; add matching cached junit-platform-launcher1.11.4. Compile the embedded corrected CatalogCheckoutMatrixTest/CatalogApiRunner outside the repository. Runner selects only declared catalog methods, not inherited baseline tests. Run all declared methods, or pass explicit method names for focused execution. Synthetic test resources remain first on classpath.
scope_limits: No browser E2E, real provider/mail/object-store operation, deployed PostgreSQL concurrency, Liquibase/schema migration constraint, third-party-cookie or cloud financial mode assertion. Browser/local approvals are unchanged.

harness_caveats: 13 success matrices. ACCESS-001 initially expected nonexistent wire status (actual DTO omits it; persisted status is checked in corrected test). PAY-007 initially dereferenced detached lazy items after both API calls had succeeded. These are harness errors, not product failures and are not scored as failed catalog cases.

scope: Only ACCESS-001 and PAY-007 rerun after fixture assertion corrections; both pass.
PAY-002 rerun only to add required exact product IDs/names/type/unique item IDs/line totals/subtotal checks; passes all six type/size combinations.

PAY-002.assertions: 1/20 unique Course, Download and Consultation items, all Published and2.25EUR from another Creator; six PENDING checkouts and buyer GETs. Exact IDs/names/types/unique item IDs, quantity1,225-minor item/line amounts, subtotal/total, future expiry, fake/null checkoutURL and one pending attempt per order match. No payment event or entitlement.

PAY-003.assertions: Absent/null/empty productIds, null ID, malformed UUID and21-ID bodies each return400 with valid auth/CSRF/key. Orders, attempts, events and entitlements remain zero after each.

PAY-004.assertions: Missing, empty, whitespace-only and129-character keys return400 without financial records.128-character key succeeds. Whitespace-padded key and trimmed replay return the same order; two accepted keys create only two pending orders and no grants.

PAY-005.assertions: Same buyer/key returns identical pending order after reordering two IDs and separate supported owner PATCHes of name, price27.50 and statusHIDDEN. DB confirms edits; order JSON/snapshots remain byte-equivalent as parsed JSON, with one order/attempt and no grants.

PAY-006.assertions: Same buyer/key with B or A+B returns409 and leaves original order only. Another synthetic buyer using the same key and Product A receives an independent order. Final two orders/attempts, no grants.

PAY-007.assertions: Two executor threads released by one latch submit identical buyer/key/product checkouts. Both201 responses share one orderId; DB has one order, one attempt and one item, no payment events or entitlements. H2 concurrency scope; not deployed PostgreSQL race coverage.

PAY-008.assertions: Duplicate IDs, unknown-only ID and valid-plus-unknown ID each return422. Orders, attempts, events and entitlements stay zero after each; no partial checkout.

PAY-009.assertions: Otherwise-valid cart plus zero-price, null-price, Draft or Hidden Course each returns422. Orders, attempts, events and grants stay zero; no partial checkout.

PAY-010.assertions: Legacy Published positive-priced recurring Membership and non-Membership Course carrying recurring metadata each return422. No order, attempt, event or entitlement/subscription bypass.

PAY-011.assertions: Creator buyer-owned paid Product and separately legacy Admin buyer-owned paid Product each return422. No orders, attempts, events or grants; Admin role does not bypass self-purchase rejection.

PAY-012.assertions: Two Published paid Products from different Creators return422 under valid buyer auth/CSRF. No order, attempt, event or entitlement, including partial checkout.

PAY-015.assertions: Known pending order is readable by buyer and Admin with equal order JSON. Selling Creator/unrelated User each403; unknown order404; Guest401. Reads leave one pending order and no grants.

ACCESS-001.assertions: User, Creator and Admin each enroll in Published Course/Download/legacy Consultation with null and zero price:18 combinations. Each201 creates one caller-owned ACTIVE/FREE_ENROLLMENT record with null revokedAt/purchase reference; own Library and access=true reads persist it.18 total grants, no monetary order/event.

ACCESS-003.assertions: User, Creator and Admin each try paid Published, free Draft, free Hidden and missing Product:12 combinations. Paid402, nonpublished403, missing404; zero grants and monetary orders throughout.

ACCESS-006.assertions: Owner, Admin and ACTIVE holder return true; same holder after revocation and unrelated User return false; Guest401. Owner/Admin create no grants. Seeded grant remains a single record; access reads add none.

parent_scope: All explicit role/input/assertion variations for these fifteen API cases are accounted for within the catalog-authorized isolated backend environment. Cloud/browser cases remain separate.
